empty.message: Create an app to let people sign in to your product with their Jawabin account and use the Public API on their behalf.

confidential.label: Confidential
confidential.hint: Has a server that keeps the client secret, like a web app with a backend.

public.label: Public
public.hint: Runs where a secret can't stay hidden: a browser, mobile, or desktop app. Uses PKCE only.

endpoint.title: Login with Jawabin
endpoint.subtitle: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE. Access tokens are JWTs for the Public API with Authorization: Bearer.
endpoint.hint: Access tokens last 1 hour, refresh tokens 30 days after their last use. Scopes follow the Public API menus.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Shown to people on the consent page.

description.label: Description (optional)

redirect.label: Redirect URIs
redirect.hint: Matched exactly. Use https, http only for localhost, or an app scheme like com.example.app:/callback.
redirect.required: Add at least one redirect URI

secret.title: Client Secret
secret.warning: Copy the client secret now. Jawabin keeps only a fingerprint of it, so it can't be shown again.

rotate.title: Make a new client secret?
rotate.message: The current secret stops working right away, so update your server with the new one. People who connected stay connected.

remove.title: Delete this app?
remove.message: Everyone connected to {name} is disconnected and its tokens stop working right away.

verify.hint: People see a warning on the consent page until Jawabin verifies the app. Send a request to customer service; they'll check the app and its website.

disabled.title: Jawabin disabled this app
disabled.message: Everyone connected to it was disconnected, and it can't sign people in anymore. It can't be changed or deleted.
